## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] A changeset is included (`npx changeset`, or `npx changeset --empty`)
- [ ] README / MIGRATION.md updated for public API or breaking changes
